caption:
it was never about your discipline

#fitness #wellness #workout

slides.text:
Nobody tells you why
most fitness plans fail

slides.bg: a pair of rubber dumbbells on a dark gym floor next to a printed generic workout plan on paper, warm low side light, shallow depth of field, no people
slides.text:
They were built for
someone else's body

Generic plan,
generic results

Your sleep, stress and cycle
never made it into the math

A plan should start
from your data

Not from a template

slides.heading: That's what SOMA does
slides.body: It reads your wearables and rebuilds the plan every morning — for your body, not the average one
